The official 2024 annual report identifies Liu Zhonghua, Song Yuhong, and Hou Lingling as independent directors and Zhang Ying as a departed independent director; a personnel-change entry gives Zhang Ying departure date as 2024-05-18.
The audit-committee meeting table nevertheless lists Zhang Ying among four members for meetings dated 2024-08-23 and 2024-10-25, creating an internal chronology conflict in the report.
The reviewed committee-meeting entries do not identify a convener; regulations in the retrieved context were not verified for historical applicability.
